name: mod-dev
description: Holds Claude to one rule: never say a change is done before it's proven. Gates stopping and pushing on fresh checks and a reviewer that reads the codebase; /score shows the scorecard

model.title: Reviewer model
model.description: The model that reviews the change. It reads the requests, the diff, the ledger of checks, the instruction files and the repository itself, never the session's own reasoning

lookModel.title: Looking model
lookModel.description: The model that reads around the repository (sibling files, callers, installed docs) before the reviewer judges. A cheaper one keeps reviews fast

gate.title: Hold Claude to proof
gate.description: Send Claude back when it stops with an edited change that isn't proven, and refuse to push or open a pull request for one
